children: SafeSpace Global plans investor presentations in New York and has posted its investor decks online.
SafeSpace Global will meet and present to potential investors in New York City Sept 8–10, 2026.
The company posted Investor Presentations under the “Invest” tab at https://safespaceglobal.ai.
Investor Presentations are attached to the 8‑K as Exhibit 99.1 and Exhibit 99.2 and are incorporated by reference.
Company expects to make future investor presentations available on its website and via Form 8‑K filings.
